desc_id: Pada tahun 2024, saya memulai perjalanan sebagai mahasiswa Informatika di UPN "Veteran" Jawa Timur. Saya mempelajari dasar pemrograman C, C++, dan Python sembari memahami algoritma serta pemecahan masalah.
desc_en: In 2024, I began my journey as an Informatics student at UPN "Veteran" Jawa Timur. During this year, I learned the fundamentals of programming through C, C++, and Python while building my understanding of algorithms.
learn_id: Setiap ahli memulai langkahnya dengan menguasai hal mendasar.
learn_en: Every expert begins by mastering the fundamentals.

desc_id: Seiring bertambahnya pemahaman, saya mulai menerapkan ilmu lewat proyek akademik dan mandiri seperti sistem perpustakaan Java dan desain antarmuka aplikasi.
desc_en: As my understanding grew, I started applying what I had learned through academic and personal projects such as Java systems and UI/UX designs.
learn_id: Kemajuan datang dari latihan nyata, bukan dari kesempurnaan instan.
learn_en: Progress comes from practice, not perfection.

desc_id: Tahun 2026 menjadi fase menantang di mana saya membangun portofolio pribadi, platform web e-commerce, dan sistem silsilah keluarga digital.
desc_en: In 2026, I challenged myself with more advanced projects. I started building my personal website portfolio and client-based web platforms.
learn_id: Teknologi memberi dampak terbesar ketika mampu menyelesaikan masalah nyata.
learn_en: Technology creates the greatest impact when it solves real problems.

desc_id: Saat ini, saya terus memperluas wawasan di bidang Full-Stack Development, Web3, UI/UX Design, dan rekayasa perangkat lunak.
desc_en: Today, I continue expanding my knowledge in Full-Stack Development, Web3, UI/UX Design, and software engineering.
learn_id: Pertumbuhan adalah perjalanan berkelanjutan, bukan sekadar garis akhir.
learn_en: Growth is a continuous journey, not a destination.
